body:
Placeholder for a decision the maintainer wants to take when publishing on F-Droid comes up;
deliberately blocked. Not part of the multi-account steps, but touches the same update path.

## What is known

* F-Droid builds from source and signs with **its own key**. An F-Droid install can therefore
  not be updated by the APK the server embeds (`/shoppinglist.apk`, T-59): Android refuses the
  install as a signature mismatch, and the "update required" screen (T-244) would offer a
  download that cannot succeed.
* Maintainer's thought (2026-09-24): once the app is on F-Droid the server need not publish the
  APK any more; the "download the app" link can simply point at the F-Droid store page.

## Surfaces that would change

* server: `routes/apk.py`, `routes/landing.py` (`apk_url`), `routes/app_version.py`
  (`download_url`), `release.sh` (embeds the APK into the wheel and compares signing certs).
* web: `LoginPage.tsx` download link (currently shown only when `HEAD /shoppinglist.apk` is ok).
* android: `UpdateChecker`/`UpdateRequiredScreen` follow `download_url`; nothing else.
* docs: `wire-contract.md` `/app-version` section; `android/README.md` reproducible-build notes
  from the T-281 review (build from a clean checkout, pinned toolchain, no `local.properties`
  secrets).

## To decide when we get there

* Keep serving the APK for self-hosters who sideload, or drop it entirely.
* Whether `download_url` becomes a store link, a config option per instance, or goes away and the
  app just stops offering downloads on builds it detects as F-Droid-signed.
* App id stays `org.p23q.shoppinglist`; the display name is Tuppu. F-Droid metadata wants the
  source repo, licence and a changelog format — check `fastlane/metadata` conventions.
title: F-Droid publishing: app download link, server-embedded APK and update path (design, decide later)
